THE LACK OF OUTLET AND HIGH EVAPORATION RATE CAUSE THESE SALTS TO ACCUMULATE, RESULTING IN A SALINITY OF ~34%, FAR EXCEEDING OCEANIC LEVELS. THIS EXTREME SALINITY CREATES A DENSE, BUOYANT WATER THAT SUPPORTS ONLY EXTREME MICROORGANISMS, NOT COMPLEX LIFE FORMS.
